sources.quote: BR-220 at TO1 for STL has one approved material source: Alluminio B S.r.l. (Settimo Torinese).
A source that is not listed for a part, plant and customer has no approval.
A temporary deviation does not approve a new material source.

findings.why: The ASL is the complete controlled list for TO1/STL. Meccanica C is not listed for BR-220. Its only approvals are BR-180 and BR-310. Approval is per part, plant and customer, and the supplier audit does not grant a part approval. A deviation cannot approve the source either.

sources.quote: 8.5.6.1 A change of material source, of a sub-supplier, or of the manufacturing location of a sub-supplier needs a documented risk analysis and written approval from Stellantis before any shipment of affected parts.
BOM-LINE 120: part BR-220 (drawing Rev C); program STL-Torino-27; customer STL; material EN AW-6082-T6; features: 4 fastener holes

findings.why: BR-220 belongs to STL-Torino-27, which is in Annex A of the STL CSR. Switching the billet source from Alluminio B to Meccanica C is a material source change. It needs a documented risk analysis and written Stellantis approval before shipment. No document in force covers it.

sources.quote: Cracks at fastener holes found on machined brackets made from EN AW-6061-T6 (alloy group 6xxx).
A material-related contribution has not been excluded.
Material: EN AW-6082-T6 billet (alloy group 6xxx, Al-Mg-Si).

findings.why: Meccanica C has an OPEN 8D on cracks at fastener holes in 6xxx alloy brackets, and a material contribution is not excluded. BR-220 is also a 6xxx alloy (6082-T6) with 4 fastener holes. The email of 2026-11-05 confirms the 8D remains open.

sources.quote: Yield strength Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa. SPECIAL CHARACTERISTIC SC-01, controlled per control plan CP-BR220-R3.
Rev B is superseded and withdrawn as of 2026-06-01.
per il BR-220 il materiale e' EN AW-6061-T6 con Rp0.2 minimo 240 MPa, quindi il billet di C va bene.
supplier Meccanica C S.p.A. (Chieri); billet grade EN AW-6061-T6; status APPROVED 2024-09-02 (PPAP-2024-077)

findings.why: The email relies on the withdrawn Rev B (6061-T6, 240 MPa). Rev C, which is in force, requires EN AW-6082-T6 with Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01). Meccanica C's known billet grade is 6061-T6, which does not meet this. Informal email cannot override the drawing.

sources.quote: Material certificate EN 10204 type 3.1 required with each lot.
Material certificates are not stored in this record.

findings.why: No 3.1 certificate or tensile result exists for any Meccanica C 6082-T6 billet lot. Grade, temper and Rp0.2 >= 250 MPa (SC-01) cannot be verified. Someone must say whether such a certificate exists.
